Game is fun, a bit slow starting off, but you will snowball the more runs you do. Would be cool to get a prestige system in the game for longevity. 8.5/10

作为一款塔防游戏，可以自由组合不同攻击方式的塔柱和不同攻击效果的水晶(比如机枪塔柱上可以放毒水晶快速叠dot也可以单纯放攻击水晶打伤害)；可以用装备提升防御塔的属性、赋予不同效果；防御塔也可以打怪升级解锁特长(升级经验值似乎是根据hit数来的，攻速慢的塔升级慢)； 作为一款肉鸽游戏，有局外养成要素，也就是天赋树，各种效果的塔柱、水晶升级天赋都是分开的(但是洗点会掉级)；在打通普通难度后，可以解锁装备合成配方(只要是塔的装备栏对应装备全绿，就算是激活配方，不会有合成那一套)；每一关的地图地形都是随机生成的，如果运气不好战线拉很长会导致塔的利用率变低； 综上，虽然画面差了点但是游戏性绝对ok(后面战斗场面又是一大堆数字又是各种水火特效的，画面好一点就不一定优化好一点了)，可以期待正式版更多的地图、装备和模式。 老样子，贴个指南： https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3192530893

Honestly I simply love this game. It is addictive, loads of fun, and has an enormously cool progression system that more than once made me say: 'Well I just want to see how these items will interact'. It has its share of kinks to work out, but the developer has shown themselves to be invested and willing to make this game succeed. Honestly if you have the money to spare and just want a ridiculously fun game to just waste some time with, this is definitely the game for you.

Thumbs up from me. However the game still needs alot of updates, bug fixing, and balance - currently I think at full price its a bit overpriced. Developer has been making constant daily updates since launch. Update: Where da patches at? They are desperately needed. This game has great potential but it needs WORK! Update 2: Its been 4 months since we last got an update. Changed my review to thumbs down.

Solid tower defense game, still in the works but already really fun. Edit after 13 hours: There are still some balancing issues that will need to be undertaken but honestly this is a wonderfully put together TD game already in EA. So you have tower types that can be modified by crystals you place on them, then that tower can be modified by loot items you gather during the run (you can stack multiple on each tower), those items can then synergize and turn the tower into a whole other beast and that's not counting the tower levels which unlock powers for each tower (you choose one of two) and all of this is affected by stats and modifiers from the progression/skill tree. This allows for crazy amounts of differing runs and replay value right out of the gate. The enemy types are varied, there are sub-bosses and main bosses, Multiple run game/run types and and and and. If you're into tower defense games, give this one a shot. You'll probably have a lot of fun.

It's currently 4:49am. I am a middle aged man. I should be in bed by now, but I'm not, because I've been playing this game for so long. The combination of random pathing and elevation changing the tower's range along with a good selection of towers and crystals which change their stats it so damn addictive. Oh and there are items to equip to your towers, combinations of certain items that give your towers special attacks and powers. It's such a simple concept but works so well and gives an incredible amount of variety in what you can do. I can't seem to stop playing until I'm exhausted or I've unlocked just a few more progression points that will make my next run different and better. I should be in bed dammit. Stupid game, I love it.

Somewhat similar to Rogue Tower, but higher production value and worse mechanics. 1. Maze is discovered (as in premade), instead of built as in Rogue Tower. The whole aspect of how you choose to build your maze is thus missing. Getting the maze building right was what Rogue Tower an awesome TD, and sadly Crystal Guardians is very far from that. 2. Crystal Guardian leans much more into building the perfect tower (with items), and this aspect is well done. You really need to find "broken" builds to survive the later levels, and while a bit fiddly; it is fun and challenging enough. However, since the game revolves around building single all-powerfull towers, rather than building a complete defense, many of the game mechanics can simply be ignored. Where to build towers, which parts of the maze to open up, which enemies are coming next are next to inconsequencal. You simply need to find that way to get unlock insane scaling on one tower, and if you don't you will for certain lose. Would have given it a negative review if it was double the price, but at this price point it was a fair amount of enjoyment for a fair price.

This is it. This is the game I've been looking for that scratches the same itch as Rogue Tower and Gemcraft: Forstborn Wrath. The tower and crystal types are varied enough that each feels unique in its purpose. The pacing of the game itself is right where it needs to be and doesn't suffer from tedious early/mid game. And to top it all off, the meta progression is hefty enough even in early access that I've been able to sink 40ish hours into this little gem and only recently maxed out the tree. No crashes, bug free from my playthroughs and runs beautifully even with all the particle effects on full blast. My hats off to this developer, as they have done something that a lot of AAA companies can't seem to get right these days and released a full fledged product that is fully playable. If this game has caught your eye, do not hesitate and pull the trigger. The only downside is I wish there was more content. However, at 40ish hours played, I've definitely gotten my money's worth and the developer seems very active and responsive. The content that is here is phenomenal and I'm sure that any additions will have the same love and care put into them as well. 10/10 Going in the favorites folder.

A great game to get back into tower defense with! The simple graphics are complemented by minute detailed power ups and add ons that allow you to make your defense as tough as needed, I had fun playing it :)

Best TD game I have ever played! 10/10!! Few things that I wish the game has: - It would be cool if the damage numbers had different colors to represent their value. For example, low damage (like 10-100) could be gray, medium damage (100-10,000) could be white, high damage (10,000-100,000) could be green, and very high damage (over 100,000) could be red. - please add % health to target selection. I really want to have a run with sniper trait but it is just not working since the turret could only focus either target with highest current hp or target with most max hp.

I've bought maybe 15 tower defense games over the last year or two trying to find the right mix with roguelike. Another reviewer (Ailryden) said it best, this is it.. This was what I was looking for. The item combinations, tower variations, elite fights. This game as it stands is already the one I wanted. More updates can only make this great game better. Keep going, Tim. I'm rooting for ya!

It's a nice looking tower defense, but the difficulty spike at certain waves requires that you grind out the progression unlocks to stand a chance. There are some missing assets for some of the items and balance seems all over the place as far as how many 'rolls' you will receive for items on any given map. Maybe worth it on sale, but it needs some more time in the oven to justify full price. It also appears the developer has gone radio silent so take that for what you will.

While the strategic options all tend to lean toward similar setups, I think that's inherent in the TD genre. This one does it pretty well, though, IMO. It could stand a few QOL improvements, like an option to reduce opacity of your fire, as it can get hard to find your towers (or even the mouse pointer) once things get busy. Those are minor complaints, though, and also common to a lot of TD games.

Buyer beware as this game is not updated for a long time. The core gameplay of different crystal on variation of tower type is unique and fun. but as it is the game is full of bug, laggy at later waves (due to the number of projectiles and units) and endless waves is not fun due to exponetially buffing the enemy units.
